title: Dealbata Cornflower - 2x Mini Plug Plants -Purple Cornflower - Hardy perennial
description:
Centaurea dealbata (Perennial Cornflower) – 2x Mini Plug Plants
 

 A clump-forming perennial reaching up to 1m in height, featuring narrowly oval, lobed green leaves with a soft, whitish underside. During summer, upright stems produce lilac-pink flowers with a distinctive structure: a ring of deeply fringed outer petals surrounding a centre of paler inner petals.


 Centaurea dealbata is valued for its soft lavender-pink blooms, making it an excellent choice for borders, cottage gardens, and cut flower arrangements. It is also attractive to pollinators such as bees and butterflies.


  Growing Information:
 

  Sow indoors: August–October or March–May, lightly covering seeds with compost
 

  Sow outdoors: March–May
 

  Germination: 14–21 days at 16–20°C
 

  Transplant seedlings into 8cm pots once large enough to handle
 

  Overwinter autumn sowings under glass; plant out in spring
 

  Plant in a sunny, well-drained position
 

  Space plants 20cm apart (or thin direct sowings to this distance)
 

  Water regularly until established
 

  Sow every 2–3 weeks for a continuous display
 

  Deadhead regularly to encourage prolonged flowering
 

 Ideal for adding long-lasting summer colour and structure to garden displays.
